  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:

#   --cpus-per-task=1
#   --output=...job.out

  -n 64 \
  -c 1 \
  --queue=c6gn \

# NOTE: Slurm --job-name is not expressed here as a portable Flux batch directive.

spack load pism@1.1.4 %gcc /cijv4kn

mpirun -np 64 /usr/bin/time -f "real:%e" pismv -test B -Mx 61 -Mz 11 -ys 422.45 -y 25000 &> pismv.out
'
